title: Completed VARIANCE ANALYSIS Data Contract
description: Additive structural schema validating completed VARIANCE ANALYSIS artifact data payloads (PMO-06.04).

schedule_planned_result.description: The target baseline schedule milestone, duration, or date.

schedule_actual_result.description: The actual completed milestone date, duration, or current progress.

schedule_variance.description: Calculated difference between actual schedule performance and the baseline.

schedule_root_cause.description: Primary cause and contributing factors for schedule variance.

schedule_planned_response.description: Action plan or recovery strategy designed to address schedule variance.

cost_planned_result.description: The approved baseline budget or planned expenditure for the period.

cost_actual_result.description: The actual expenditures or costs incurred during the period.

cost_variance.description: Calculated difference between actual expenditures and the cost baseline.

cost_root_cause.description: Primary drivers and events resulting in cost overruns or savings.

cost_planned_response.description: Corrective measures and cost containment actions to realign with budget.

quality_planned_result.description: The quality metric, acceptance threshold, or standard expected.

quality_actual_result.description: The actual measured quality outcome, defect rate, or test score.

quality_variance.description: Discrepancy between actual quality achievements and defined quality metrics.

quality_root_cause.description: Root cause analysis detailing why quality requirements were not met.

quality_planned_response.description: Remediation plan, rework procedures, or process improvements.

scope_planned_result.description: The authorized deliverables and work packages committed in the scope statement.

scope_actual_result.description: The actual scope deliverables completed and verified during the period.

scope_variance.description: Extent of scope variance, unapproved scope additions, or unfinished deliverables.

scope_root_cause.description: Factors causing scope variance, creep, or delayed deliverable completions.

scope_planned_response.description: Corrective actions, change requests, or realignment to baseline scope.

implications_of_continued_variance_forec.description: Anticipated long-term impact on overall project objectives if variances persist.

escalation_required_y_n.description: Clear indication (Yes/No) whether senior leadership escalation is necessary.

escalation_details.description: Details of the specific escalation path, required decisions, and target stakeholders.

comments.description: Additional explanatory notes, cross-functional dependencies, or contextual insights.
